item.title: Kan'in Tokkyuu [Yotaka] ~Juuyoku Rensa, Manatsu no Hanabi Taikai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku
  • 発売日: 2024-02-22
  • スコア: 7.08/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姦淫特急『夜鷹』～ 獣欲連鎖、真夏の花火大会 ～
  • 英語名: Kan’in Tokkyuu [Yotaka] Juuyoku Rensa, Manatsu no Hanabi Taikai

あらすじ

The luxurious sleeper trains, Michishio and its successor Matsuba, were still running smoothly.

Now, the organization had added a new successor to the lineup: Yotaka. Alongside the Michishio in summer and Matsuba in winter, this third line was ready to go.

The plan was simple.

After the global virus outbreak, summer festivals and fireworks displays across the country were struggling to recover. By collaborating with these events, the organization aimed to attract and secure young, beautiful women.

The luxury cruise ship Uzushio has restaurants, bars, lounges, swimming pools, fitness clubs, spas, beauty salons, stores, theaters, casinos, medical offices, and other general facilities, The Uzushio is a luxury cruise ship owned by SSL, and is equipped with state-of-the-art technology, including restaurants, bars, lounges, swimming pools, fitness clubs, spas, beauty shops, theaters, casinos, and medical offices, and even has a diving service.

item.title: Festival ~Tsurumiku Wars~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku
  • 発売日: 2014-01-24
  • スコア: 6.58/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: FESTIVAL ～つるみく ウォーズ～
  • 英語名: Festival Tsurumiku Wars

别名

  • Ozuma‛＼s Fantia

あらすじ

A story is set in 20XX where a mysterious meteorite called “God’s Hammer” strikes Neo Osaka City, causing a special electromagnetic field to form around the city, turning it into a ghost town that only a few people can enter. Many people die due to the meteorite’s impact, but some survivors form small settlements in the devastated city. The settlement leaders are women who have gained power from the meteorite’s influence. However, they start fighting amongst themselves to obtain a certain object left behind at the meteorite’s impact site. The women have received a message that the chosen ones who obtain this object will save themselves and those around them. Who will be the last one standing and what the outcome will be?

Kanzaka Itsuki is a young manager who works for a comprehensive advertising agency called SOUMA AGENCY (SA). Osaka Redevelopment Business Bureau…. This is one of the official organizations that is in charge of development of Osaka. Only few people, however, know what they do. As a matter of fact, the department is an almost “illegal” legal group. Renji is the chief of the department. One day, the representative of Osaka visits him. “I wanna make a huge entertainment district in Osaka.” To put it simply, his offer is “to collect beautiful girls and make them sex slaves to carry out his plan.” There is no reason to deny…. item.title: Kan'in Tokkyuu Michishio
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tsurumiku
  • 発売日: 2008-08-29
  • スコア: 7.19/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姦淫特急満潮
  • 英語名: Kan’in Tokkyuu Michishio

あらすじ

A rumor spreads among young people that if a person gets on “that” train, he/she will disappear…. Most of them don’t believe it, but it exists…. It’s called Michishio. Michishio was invented to train young girls and make them into sex slaves. At first sight, the train is completely the same as a normal train. However, it shows its true self once in a few months. The girls who get on the train are severely trained and become sex slaves…. Seiji is a train conductor. He can do whatever he wants to the girls on the train since he has a special training ability. And another Michishio now departs….
